name: EgoFact
description: EgoFact is the first benchmark designed for multi-hop reasoning across visual and textual corpora in multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, requiring models to retrieve and integrate evidence spanning multiple modalities.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for multimodal multi-hop retrieval and reasoning that is promising but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Addresses limitations in multimodal evidence integration and reasoning; includes a localization-first framework for cross-modal video reasoning.
